sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1984
STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd August, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the State Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Amendment of section 36, Act XXXIII of 1956

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1984
STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd August, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 36, Act XXXIII of 1956.--In the State Bank
of Pakistan Act, 1956 (XXXIII of 1956), in subsection (2), in the Explanation,-
(a) after the
words "Federal Government", occurring for the first time, the comma
and word, ", whether" shall be inserted;
(b) after the
words "the Government", the words and comma "or otherwise,"
shall be inserted; and
(c) the words
"but would include the amount of any other rupee loan taken from the
Federal Government" shall be omitted.
